description: This file contains helper functions for size calculations and viewport interactions within the Excalidraw project, including functions for determining element visibility, size adjustments, and coordinate transformations.

methods.name: isInvisiblySmallElement
methods.description: Determines if an element is considered invisibly small based on its size or points.

methods.name: isElementInViewport
methods.description: Checks if a given element is within the current viewport based on scene and viewport coordinates.

methods.name: isElementCompletelyInViewport
methods.description: Checks if a group of elements are fully within the viewport with optional padding.

methods.name: getPerfectElementSize
methods.description: Adjusts element size to make it perfect shape or aligned line based on tool type.

methods.name: getLockedLinearCursorAlignSize
methods.description: Calculates size for cursor alignment with optional custom angle snapping.

methods.name: getNormalizedDimensions
methods.description: Returns element dimensions with positive width and height, adjusting position if necessary.
